component.name: PosterTile
component.script:
sub onContentChanged() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("name").text = c.title m.top.findNode("seeds").text = c.seedText if c.HDGRIDPOSTERURL <> invalid and c.HDGRIDPOSTERURL <> "" m.top.findNode("art").uri = c.HDGRIDPOSTERURL end if end sub
' A visible focus ring matters more on a TV than in a browser: the user is ' across the room and there is no cursor to tell them where they are. sub onFocusChanged() m.top.findNode("focusRing").opacity = m.top.focusPercent * 0.85 end sub
